name: Malpelo Fauna and Flora Sanctuary
description: Malpelo is a barren, sheer-sided rock of about 350 hectares, rising from the Pacific roughly 500 km off Colombia's coast. Its surrounding waters form the largest no-fishing zone in the Eastern Tropical Pacific. Divers come for the steep underwater walls and caves, where schools of over 200 hammerheads and more than 1,000 silky sharks have been recorded, alongside whale sharks and giant grouper.
